ValidationRule.description: Mandating 'Is Real Form Required?' when REAL Form Max ID/Service ID is entered.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Setup.Salesforce_Library_Settings__c.Disable_VRs__c = false, OR( RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Customer_Complaint', RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Non_Customer_Complaint' ), AND( NOT( ISNEW() ), NOT( ISBLANK(IDR_Real_Form_Ref_No__c)), IDR_Real_Form_Req__c = FALSE ) )
